title: Geometric Stability and Sample Complexity for Compositional Function Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.19523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study when compositional structure yields dimension reduction in supervised learning. We frame learning as empirical risk minimization with a function-space prior: a regularization functional selects a subset of functions with favorable approximation and metric entropy. The models are compositions $f(x)=g(Ax+\Delta h(x))$, where $A\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}$ is a linear base map, $\Delta h$ is a nonlinear correction, and $g$ is an outer function; that is, $f$ is an arbitrary smooth function of a $k$-dimensional representation of the input that is linear up to a correction. We prove covering-number bounds showing that the statistical complexity of this class interpolates between an intrinsic regime, parametric in the $kd$ entries of the linear map and nonparametric only in the representation dimension $k$, and an ambient $d$-dimensional nonparametric rate; the interpolation is controlled by the correction size $\varepsilon=\|\Delta h\

translated_title: 复合函数先验的几何稳定性与样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究复合结构何时能在监督学习中产生降维效果。我们将学习问题建模为带有函数空间先验的经验风险最小化：通过一个正则化泛函选取具有良好逼近性质和度量熵的函数子集。所考虑的模型为复合形式 $f(x)=g(Ax+\Delta h(x))$，其中 $A\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}$ 是线性基映射，$\Delta h$ 是非线性修正项，$g$ 是外层函数；也就是说，$f$ 是输入的一个 $k$ 维表示（除修正项外为线性）的任意光滑函数。我们证明了覆盖数上界，表明该函数类的统计复杂度介于两种机制之间：一种是内蕴机制——对线性映射的 $kd$ 个元素呈参数化形式，仅在表示维度 $k$ 上呈非参数化形式；另一种是整个 $d$ 维空间的环境非参数速率；二者之间的插值程度由修正项大小 $\varepsilon=\|\Delta h\...$ 控制。
tldr: 该论文证明了复合函数类 f(x)=g(Ax+Δh(x)) 的覆盖数界，表明其统计复杂度可在低维内蕴参数化速率与全维非参数速率之间平滑过渡，且过渡程度由非线性修正项的大小控制。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes covering-number bounds showing that the sample complexity of compositional functions f(x)=g(Ax+Δh(x)) smoothly interpolates between an intrinsic low-dimensional parametric rate and the ambient d-dimensional nonparametric rate, governed by the size of the nonlinear correction.
